name: @temples/components
description: Declarative Web Components built on the temples template engine, with reactive state.

scripts.build: bun build src/component.ts src/reactive.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json --external @temples/engine --entry-naming "[name].[ext]" && bun build src/component.ts src/reactive.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json --external @temples/engine --minify --entry-naming "[name].min.[ext]" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
